quick_english: The teaching of the Svāyambhuva is presented in order to remove the beginningless inertness of individual selves.

tokens.grounds: Refers to the teaching or scripture of Svāyambhuva; genitive qualifying the subject matter being explained.
Fused expression: jaḍatām (inertness, accusative) qualified by anādikām (beginningless), governed by infinitive apanetum (to remove).
Dative of benefit; refers to bound individual selves (aṇu) for whom the removal is intended.

quick_english: Thus, it is explained in brief.

tokens.grounds: Instrumental indicating the manner of presentation.
Passive verb indicating that the subject matter is being taught or set forth.
Concluding particle marking the end of the statement or exposition.
